plugin.description: Requires Glamourer. Paste an Eorzea Collection glamour URL or id and GlamourLink reads its gear list from Eorzea Collection's undocumented JSON endpoint, resolves it against the game's own item and dye sheets, and applies the result to your character through Glamourer's IPC. Unmatched items are reported rather than guessed silently, and every fuzzy-matched item is labelled as a guess. Optionally saves the result as a named Glamourer design. Saved outfits keep their resolved gear, so applying one needs no call to Eorzea Collection; open /glink library to browse them. Open /glink in game to import.
